Investment Management Of Virginia Llc decreased its stake in Noble Energy Inc (NBL) by 22.05% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Investment Management Of Virginia Llc sold 21,291 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.93% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 75,245 shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.19M, down from 96,536 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Investment Management Of Virginia Llc who had been investing in Noble Energy Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $16.78 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.11% or $0.39 during the last trading session, reaching $34.86. About 3.44M shares traded. Noble Energy, Inc. (NYSE:NBL) has declined 8.04% since May 12, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 19.59% the S&P500.
Independent Franchise Partners Llp decreased its stake in Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) by 0.7% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Independent Franchise Partners Llp sold 45,063 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.21% with the market. The institutional investor held 6.38 million shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $891.85 million, down from 6.43 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Independent Franchise Partners Llp who had been investing in Johnson & Johnson for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $341.28B market cap company. It has underperformed by 10.43% the S&P500.
